The '''Central Armory''' was an area of [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] [[clone military education complex]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. It was where [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] received their [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. During the [[First Battle of Kamino]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces overran the area.
